vocab_title.message: re/read - từ & cụm từ đã lưu

vocab_intro.message: Mọi cụm từ bạn lưu cho cặp ngôn ngữ này, mới nhất ở đầu - được lưu khi đọc, chỉ lưu trên thiết bị này. $LEARNED$ xóa cụm từ và gạch chân tương ứng; $EDIT$ sửa lại nghĩa, mỗi nghĩa một dòng. Thêm nhiều nghĩa cùng lúc: ngăn cách bằng dấu chấm phẩy. Bên cạnh mỗi cụm từ là hai số đếm - kính lúp và quyển sách: số lần bạn kiểm tra từ đó (mở khung nổi), và số lần từ xuất hiện trong các bài bạn đã đọc xong - phần sách bạn chuyển qua bằng nút Tiếp dưới bài đọc, bài viết bạn đánh dấu đã đọc. Danh sách có thể sắp xếp theo cả hai tiêu chí.

options_local_intro.message: Everything re/read does happens on this device (offline): translating, the Từ điển, the Danh sách đọc, your Từ & cụm từ đã lưu. Nothing you read or select is ever sent anywhere. An internet connection is needed only when you want to Tải xuống a new translation model or a Từ điển - and only from the two URLs shown openly in those sections.

options_first_steps_intro.message: Nothing translates yet - the model that would do it is not yet on this device. Setting up takes a minute:

options_first_steps_model.message: Under "Mô hình dịch thuật", find the Cặp ngôn ngữ you need (the filter finds it fastest) and press "Tải xuống". The model is stored on this device and translates offline from then on - and the first model sets the Cặp ngôn ngữ above by itself.

options_first_steps_dictionary.message: Under "Từ điển", Tải xuống a Từ điển for the same pair (optional, but worth it) - single words then get fuller answers than a translation alone, shown in the translation bubble below the translation.

options_first_steps_pin.message: Last, pin re/read to the toolbar: the puzzle-piece icon at the right end of the bar, then the gear Tiếp theo to re/read and "Pin to Toolbar". The button opens the Trình đọc, the Danh sách đọc, your Từ & cụm từ đã lưu and the switch for the site you are on.

options_first_steps_pin_android.message: The re/read button is in the browser menu (⋮), under Extensions - it opens the Trình đọc, the Danh sách đọc, your Từ & cụm từ đã lưu and the switch for the site you are on.

options_engine_value.message: Bergamot, inside the package - translates offline

options_storage_value.message: $SIZE$ - the models, the Từ điển, the Danh sách đọc and your phrases together

options_storage_how.message: Disk space used by the extension. Từ điển take up more space than their file size because of the database structure. Deleting an article or book completely removes its text, images, Đoạn đánh dấu, notes and reading progress.

options_storage_persistent.message: Persistent storage: granted. The browser has promised not to clear this data to make room.

options_storage_at_risk.message: Persistent storage: not granted. Safari clears a site's data after about a month of use without a tap on its pages, and this extension's pages count as one site. Your phrases have a copy that survives this (the line below); the models, the Từ điển and the Danh sách đọc do not - open the Trình đọc or these Cài đặt now and then.

options_storage_backup_other.message: Copy of the vocabulary: $COUNT$ phrases, written $WHEN$ - kept where the browser does not clear data on its own.

options_storage_backup_none.message: Copy of the vocabulary: none yet - it is written with the Tiếp theo phrase you Lưu.

options_storage_marks_backup_none.message: Copy of the Đoạn đánh dấu: none yet - it is written with the Tiếp theo Đoạn đánh dấu you make.

options_storage_library_copy_none.message: Copy of the Danh sách đọc: none yet - it is written with the Tiếp theo page you Lưu or book you Nhập.

options_storage_library_copy_off.message: Copy of the Danh sách đọc: off.

options_library_copy.message: Copy of the Danh sách đọc

options_library_copy_hint.message: Creates a backup of your Danh sách đọc to protect it against automatic browser cleanups and database errors. This doubles the disk space the list takes, but keeps your saved articles safe if the database is lost.

reader_marks_delete_all_other.message: Xóa all $COUNT$ quotes of this page

reader_mark_text_changed.message: The page's text has changed since this was highlighted, so the Đoạn đánh dấu cannot be shown here.

reader_marks_missing_doc.message: Its document is no longer saved - this quote came Quay lại from the copy. Open the page again and the Đoạn đánh dấu will be there.

options_pair_hint.message: Shows the language pairs downloaded to this device. To add new languages, Tải xuống them in the

options_pair_none.message: No model or Từ điển yet - add one below

options_pair_hint_quiet.message: Without a translation model, the pair says which language you are reading and where Từ & cụm từ đã lưu are kept. Pairs come from installed models and Từ điển.

options_reading_pair_quiet.message: Reading $FROM$ - machine translation is off, and Từ & cụm từ đã lưu are kept under this pair.

options_reader_only_hint.message: Limits the underlining of Từ & cụm từ đã lưu and the translation bubble to the Trình đọc. Selecting text on an ordinary web page will only show an option to open the page in the Trình đọc. With it on, no web page can tell which of its words you have saved. On Android and iOS it is on by default.

options_keep_articles.message: Lưu in the Danh sách đọc ngoại tuyến by default

options_keep_articles_hint.message: Automatically saves every page you open in the Trình đọc for offline reading. Your saved pages, Đoạn đánh dấu and reading progress are kept safe even if the original website changes or disappears.

options_font_custom_hint.message: Type the name of a font installed on this device, for example Georgia or Noto Serif. The Chế độ đọc's Type row will then offer it as Custom. Leave the field empty to use the built-in typefaces only.

options_quiet_bubble_hint.message: Shows only the translated text in the bubble. The action buttons (such as copy or Lưu) appear only when you click or tap the bubble.

options_bubble_more.message: Show the sentence and Từ điển entries right away

options_bubble_more_hint.message: When you select text, the bubble shows right away what is otherwise shown only after a press on "More": the translated sentence and the Từ điển entries. Worth keeping on with a Từ điển installed - a translation model often gets a single word wrong, and the Từ điển shows what it really means. The bubble over an already saved phrase shows only the saved translation - the sentence and the Từ điển entries appear after you press "More".

options_underline_forms.message: Underline other forms of saved words

options_underline_forms_hint.message: A saved word is underlined in its other forms too: Lưu "read", and "reads" and "reading" are underlined as well - the bubble over them shows what you saved for "read". Which forms count is decided by your Từ điển for the language you read, so one has to be installed. For now only when you read English. Switched off, only the exact form you saved is underlined.

options_save_sentence.message: Lưu the sentence with the phrase

options_save_sentence_hint.message: When you Lưu a phrase from the bubble, the sentence around it is saved with it - the sentence as the page shows it, without its translation. It is shown under the phrase on the Từ & cụm từ đã lưu page, folded to one line, and written into the third column of the Xuất for Anki. For a phrase saved without a sentence, the sentence around it is saved the Tiếp theo time you open its bubble on a page. Like the phrase, the sentence is stored only on this device. Switched off, no new sentence is saved; the ones already saved are not deleted.

options_no_translation_hint.message: Turns off machine translation (the model). The Trình đọc, the Danh sách đọc ngoại tuyến and the highlighter keep working. With a Cặp ngôn ngữ chosen, the bubble still shows Từ điển meanings, and you can Lưu phrases and see their underlines. Ideal for reading with Từ điển or in your native language. Your saved data is not deleted and returns when you turn this off.

options_bubble_off_hint.message: With this on, selecting text on an ordinary page does nothing at all - open a page in the Trình đọc from re/read's button or with Alt+Shift+R. In the Trình đọc a selection is only a Đoạn đánh dấu for the moment: no bubble opens, a tap or Escape clears it, and Ctrl+C or Cmd+C copies it (on a touch screen nothing can be copied).

options_bubble_scale_hint.message: Adjusts the text and button size inside the translation bubble across all pages.

options_tts_hint.message: Enables the text-to-speech function. Turning this off hides all read-aloud buttons in the bubble, lists, and the Trình đọc.

options_tts_voice_hint.message: Select the voice used to read phrases and articles in each language. Only voices that speak offline are offered: speech is made on this device and nothing is sent to the internet.

speech_no_offline_voice.message: Thiết bị này không có giọng đọc ngoại tuyến cho ngôn ngữ này.

options_models_intro.message: Tải xuống a translation model here for each Cặp ngôn ngữ you want to translate. These are official Mozilla files that run entirely offline on your device.

options_models_single_word.message: A model translates sentences well, but a single word on its own is often translated wrongly - the result is cut short, or is a word that does not exist. For single words, a Từ điển from the section below is the better source.

options_filter_models_label.message: Filter the list of Mô hình dịch thuật

options_filter_dictionaries_label.message: Filter the list of Từ điển

options_model_note_rest.message: - where Mozilla publishes them. The extension connects to this public server only when you press Cập nhật the list or Tải xuống. No personal data is ever sent.

options_add_model_summary.message: To add by hand a model the list above does not offer, load its files here.

options_add_model_intro.message: Pick the three files of one direction and they are stored locally. Gzipped files are unpacked here, so the downloads can be used as they come:

options_files_note.message: Adding a model by hand makes no network request, and this page stays the way in on the day the place models are downloaded from stops answering.

options_dictionaries_intro.message: Add Từ điển to see detailed word definitions in the translation bubble. You can change the order in which they appear using the arrows.

options_dictionaries_sources.message: The Từ điển listed below come from WikDict. You can also add your own - from files or from a link, and several for one language - in the sections under the list. Where to find them, each with its licence:

options_dictionary_order_hint.message: The bubble answers in the order below. Only the Từ điển of the language you are reading answer.

options_dictionary_note_rest.message: - where WikDict publishes the Từ điển it builds from Wiktionary (CC BY-SA). The extension connects to this public server only when you press Cập nhật the list or Tải xuống. No personal data is ever sent.

options_add_dictionary_heading.message: Add a Từ điển from files

options_add_dictionary_summary.message: Nhập your own Từ điển in the StarDict format. Unpack the archive, select the required files (.ifo, .idx, .dict), choose the languages and press Add Từ điển.

options_file_ifo.message: - what the Từ điển calls itself

options_file_syn.message: - other spellings, when the Từ điển has them

options_add_dictionary_mono.message: A monolingual Từ điển works too, for example English-English: choose the same language on both sides.

options_dict_files_note.message: Adding from files makes no network request. Any StarDict files work, including the catalogue's own, which are published at

options_add_link_heading.message: Add a Từ điển from a link

options_add_link_summary.message: Paste the address of a StarDict Từ điển packed as a .zip file, choose the languages and press Tải xuống. The extension connects to that address once, when you press the button, and to nowhere else; nothing of yours is sent along. The archive is unpacked and checked on this device, exactly like files you pick yourself.

options_link_sources.message: Where to find Từ điển, monolingual ones too - English-English, for example - each with its licence:

options_link_note.message: Only https addresses are accepted. An archive that is not a .zip file (.tar.xz, .tar.zst) has to be unpacked and added from files.

options_link_answered_by.message: The address led to $HOST$, and the archive came from there.

options_disabled_intro.message: A list of websites where the extension is switched off: no translation, no bubble, no underlines. Add a site with the switch under the extension's icon in the browser's toolbar while you are on it, or type its address below. There is no switch when both "Use without a translation model" and "No bubble when selecting text" are on: nothing happens on ordinary pages then, so there is nothing to switch off.

options_add_host_note.message: The address as the browser shows it, for example example.org; www.example.org is the same site. A subdomain such as news.example.org is a separate site. A page's whole address can be pasted; only the site part is kept.

options_host_invalid.message: That is not a site address.

options_custom_css_intro.message: For changing how the bubble, the Trình đọc page and the toolbar popup look with CSS rules of your own. This page stays out of their reach, so a wrong rule can always be undone here: clear the field and Lưu.

options_custom_css_more.message: More about the CSS rules and the names

options_custom_css_reach.message: The rules apply inside the translation bubble, on the Trình đọc page - its bar and lists included - and in the toolbar button's window, never on the pages you read. A wrong rule can break the look or the controls of those places until the field is cleared.

options_custom_css_rules.message: Rules that would load anything from the network (url(), @Nhập, @font-face) are refused. The names of the elements are kept from version to version where possible; when one has to change, the release notes say so. The names come from these files:

options_custom_css_refused.message: Not saved: the rules were refused. Rules that load anything from the network (url(), @Nhập, @font-face) are not allowed.

options_custom_css_example.message: Example: .bubble { outline: 3px solid darkorange; } draws an orange line around every bubble.

options_custom_css_cleared.message: Saved: no rules, so the default look.

options_support_intro.message: re/read is built by a non-profit foundation - no investors, no ads, no tracking. If you find it useful and want to support its continued development, every donation helps us build software free from commercial pressure.
